test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The teacher said, “William Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-Avon.”

options.text: The teacher said that William Shakespeare have been born in Stratford-upon-Avon.
The teacher said that William Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-Avon.
The teacher said that William Shakespeare has been born in Stratford-upon-Avon.
The teacher said that William Shakespeare is born in Stratford-upon-Avon.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The teacher said that William Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-Avon.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In indirect speech, also known as reported speech, we report what someone else has said. 
 
• The verb "**said**" remains the same in both direct and indirect speech.
 
• The quotation marks around the direct speech are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The conjunction "**that**" is used to introduce the reported statement.
 
• The verb tense in the reported statement may shift back to one tense, depending on the context.
 
• In this case, the past tense "**was born**" remains the same in both direct and indirect speech because it is a historical fact.
 
• So, the reported speech version accurately conveys what the teacher said in a grammatically correct manner.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
